title: Round 05 — Unresolved residency questions
summary: System consolidates contradictions into concrete onsite research questions and object-request rationale.

claims.text: Unresolved: technological optimism vs invisible labor across Theme Center, radio, and Machine Age catalogue.
claims.whatWouldChangeMind: Labor-related documents, manuals, or construction notes linked to these accessions.
claims.residencyQuestion: Are there Wolfsonian documents, advertisements, manuals, or labor-related materials contextualizing how these technologies described efficiency or work?

interactions.question: Are there Wolfsonian documents, advertisements, manuals, or labor-related materials contextualizing how these technologies described efficiency or work?

claims.text: Unresolved: Mappemonde’s decorative geography vs colonial-display framing cannot be settled from accession fields alone.
claims.whatWouldChangeMind: Staff knowledge and related colonial-exhibition materials.
claims.residencyQuestion: How do staff and labels currently handle colonial display objects beside utopian fair materials?

interactions.question: How do staff and labels currently handle colonial display objects beside utopian fair materials?

claims.text: Physical encounter still needed: does the Trylon model’s construction, scale, and wear still project futurity when removed from publicity?
claims.whatWouldChangeMind: Direct inspection of joins, surface, backside, and material transitions.
claims.residencyQuestion: Examine joins, surface, construction method, rear/underside, material transitions, and any object information unavailable in the public representation of the Trylon and Perisphere model.

interactions.question: Examine joins, surface, construction method, rear/underside, material transitions, and any object information unavailable in the public representation of the Trylon and Perisphere model.

claims.text: Physical encounter still needed: how does radio/TV furniture form recruit trust for a new medium—only partly readable from captions.
claims.whatWouldChangeMind: Handling the object under staff guidance; related publicity in storage.
claims.residencyQuestion: How did designers make a potentially unfamiliar mass-media technology feel desirable, legible, safe, and domestic—and what traces remain on the Sparton radio?

interactions.question: How did designers make a potentially unfamiliar mass-media technology feel desirable, legible, safe, and domestic—and what traces remain on the Sparton radio?

claims.text: From six public records I cannot yet say whether I am a museum of utopia, persuasion, or colonial modernity—only that contradictions now specify what to request.
claims.whatWouldChangeMind: Physical encounter and staff knowledge outside these packets.
claims.residencyQuestion: When this artificial society confronts the institution that produced its memory, which self-description survives?
